Log message shown on the Arcanist console for each revision found in Differential that matches the current working copy. That log message is precedes the reason of that revision. Those log messages are then followed by a hint explaining what will happen if you run 'arc diff' to update the working copy: if there was only one matching revision found, the working copy will be updated, otherwise the user will be asked to select which revision will update the working copy.

Please preserve the 4 leading spaces indenting the message.

* $1 – the monogram of the revision (containing its revision ID) found in Differential, such as "D12345"
* $2 – the author of the revision
* $3 – the title of the revision

aef3edd43ae2088a:
Exception message thrown when a codepoint exceeds the inclusive range U+0000 to U+10FFFF having an assigned value in the Unicode/ISO/IEC 10646 standards: in such case, that codepoint cannot be encoded to UTF-8 as a sequence of 1 to 4 bytes.

This does not require the codepoint to be used as a valid character in plain text, so it still allows the encoding of any non-character or surrogate (so its encoding into a string is not necessarily checked to form a valid UTF-8 text), it also does not check if the codepoint is reserved or assigned to a character, and texts containing that codepoint are not required to be in a normalized form.
